summary: Tested PlayStation Lounge management app (Arabic RTL, dark theme, no auth). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass covering all 16 rooms seed, room update, products CRUD, full session lifecycle (start/double-start-400/active-with-live-costs/add-item-with-stock-decrement/remove-item-with-stock-restore/stop), cafeteria standalone sale + empty-cart 400, sessions/history, and reports for today/week/month/all (totals reconcile). Frontend: All 5 screens load via Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. No console errors. testIDs present and selectable on every interactive element.

issues: Many deprecation warnings in Expo logs: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Image style.resizeMode deprecated. Functional but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Address deprecation warnings: replace shadow* with boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode -> resizeMode prop.

(Optional) Note: Alert.alert confirm dialogs on web map to window.confirm. Start-session via tap on idle room cannot be auto-tested via Playwright easily; backend POST /api/rooms/{id}/start was verified directly and works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (~470 lines, single file is fine for current scope). Excludes _id correctly via projection {'_id': 0}. All endpoints async. Pydantic validation in place. Idempotent seed (count==0 check).
Stock concurrency: add_session_item checks then $inc separately - small race window under concurrent load. Acceptable for single-shop usage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (5/5 screens load with correct counts and testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ products. Started+stopped one session on the last room (room order=16), now closed - visible in reports history. Standalone cafeteria sale of 0.50 JD created (visible in 'today' report).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend reachable at https://gaming-cafe-admin-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Suite at /app/backend/tests/test_playstation_api.py is reusable. 16 rooms and 10 products seed automatically. Frontend tabs use Expo Router file-based routing at /, /cafeteria, /products, /reports, /settings.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All requested features pass.
